lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    cases ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1 with
    | inl v =>
      have := l.canonical_form_abs v
      grind
    | inr h => grind
  case tapp der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der.wf.2.1 with
    | inl v =>
      have := der.canonical_form_tabs v
      grind
    | inr h => grind
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases ih rfl der.wf.2.1 with
    | inl v =>
      have := der.canonical_form_sum v
      grind
    | inr h => grind
  all_goals grind
